name: watch shapes jobs
command:
while true; do st=$(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8321/api/jobs | python3 -c "
import json,sys
js = {j['id']: j for j in json.load(sys.stdin)}
j1, j3 = js.get(1,{}).get('state'), js.get(3,{}).get('state')
print(j1, j3)
if j1 in ('done','error') and j3 in ('done','error'): exit(0)
exit(1)"); echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) job1/job3: $st"; echo "$st" | grep -qE "done|error" && exit 0; sleep 60; done
description: watch shapes jobs 1 and 3 until terminal
